# Milestone 3 — exact table schemas

<!-- Generated by scripts/render_lakehouse_tables.py from
     src/fleetforge/lakehouse/tables.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

Catalog `lake` (Iceberg JDBC catalog; the same name in Spark and Trino).
Common table properties: `format-version=2`, `write.format.default=parquet`, `write.metadata.delete-after-commit.enabled=true`, `write.metadata.previous-versions-max=50`, `write.parquet.compression-codec=zstd`.

Identity columns are a logical key. Iceberg does not enforce uniqueness: the writer guarantees it and tests check it.

## `bronze.kafka_records`

Immutable copy of every ingested Kafka record, schema-agnostic. One row per (kafka_topic_id, kafka_partition, kafka_offset).

* Status: implemented (slice 1)
* Identity: `(kafka_topic_id, kafka_partition, kafka_offset)`
* Partitioning: `source_topic, days(ingested_at)`
* Sort order: `kafka_partition, kafka_offset`

| Column | Spark | Iceberg | Trino | Null | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `source_topic` | STRING | string | varchar | no | Kafka topic name. |
| `kafka_topic_id` | STRING | string | varchar | no | Kafka topic id (incarnation). Changes when a topic is deleted and recreated. |
| `kafka_partition` | INT | int | integer | no | Kafka partition. |
| `kafka_offset` | BIGINT | long | bigint | no | Kafka offset within the partition. |
| `kafka_timestamp` | TIMESTAMP | timestamptz | timestamp(6) with time zone | yes | Kafka record timestamp. FleetForge topics use CreateTime (producer clock). Transport metadata, never used for ordering. |
| `kafka_timestamp_type` | STRING | string | varchar | no | CREATE_TIME, LOG_APPEND_TIME or NONE. |
| `record_key` | BINARY | binary | varbinary | yes | Exact key bytes (telemetry: UTF-8 robot_id). |
| `record_value` | BINARY | binary | varbinary | yes | Exact value bytes. NULL is a tombstone. |
| `record_headers` | ARRAY&lt;STRUCT&lt;key: STRING, value: BINARY&gt;&gt; | list&lt;struct&lt;key: string, value: binary&gt;&gt; | array(row(key varchar, value varbinary)) | yes | Kafka headers in record order (outbox topics carry eventType and outboxCreatedAt). |
| `value_sha256` | STRING | string | varchar | yes | Lowercase hex SHA-256 of record_value. |
| `value_framing` | STRING | string | varchar | no | CONFLUENT (magic byte 0 and a 4-byte schema id), NONE (any other bytes) or TOMBSTONE. Read from the bytes only: says nothing about whether the body decodes. |
| `value_schema_id` | BIGINT | long | bigint | yes | Registry schema id from the framing (unsigned 32-bit); NULL unless CONFLUENT. |
| `ingestion_run_id` | STRING | string | varchar | no | Bronze ingestion run that wrote this row. |
| `ingested_at` | TIMESTAMP | timestamptz | timestamp(6) with time zone | no | Start of that run (lakehouse clock), constant within a run. Part of the deterministic arrival order. |

## `bronze.registry_schemas`

Archive of every schema id seen in Bronze, so history stays decodable even if the schema registry loses its storage. Insert-if-absent; an id never changes meaning.

* Status: implemented (slice 1)
* Identity: `(schema_id)`
* Partitioning: unpartitioned
* Sort order: none

| Column | Spark | Iceberg | Trino | Null | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `schema_id` | BIGINT | long | bigint | no | Registry global schema id. |
| `status` | STRING | string | varchar | no | FOUND, or NOT_FOUND when the registry answered 404 while it demonstrably held the subject (an authoritative absence, never a transport failure). |
| `schema_type` | STRING | string | varchar | yes | AVRO for FOUND rows. |
| `schema_text` | STRING | string | varchar | yes | Schema exactly as returned by the registry. |
| `schema_sha256` | STRING | string | varchar | yes | Lowercase hex SHA-256 of schema_text. |
| `registry_url` | STRING | string | varchar | no | Registry the schema was fetched from. |
| `first_seen_topic` | STRING | string | varchar | no | Topic whose record referenced the id. |
| `archived_at` | TIMESTAMP | timestamptz | timestamp(6) with time zone | no | When the id was archived. |
| `ingestion_run_id` | STRING | string | varchar | no | Run that archived it. |

## `silver.telemetry_events`

Validated canonical telemetry: one row per accepted event_id, canonical units. Ordered by (robot_id, boot_number, sequence_number), never by robot clock.

* Status: implemented (slice 1)
* Identity: `(event_id)`
* Partitioning: `days(observed_at), bucket(16, robot_id)`
* Sort order: `robot_id, boot_number, sequence_number`

| Column | Spark | Iceberg | Trino | Null | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `event_id` | STRING | string | varchar | no | Producer event identity (stable across redeliveries). |
| `robot_id` | STRING | string | varchar | no | Robot. |
| `boot_id` | STRING | string | varchar | no | Boot session. |
| `boot_number` | BIGINT | long | bigint | no | Server-assigned boot ordinal. Copied from the event: the lakehouse cannot verify it against the boot registry (contract gap G2). |
| `sequence_number` | BIGINT | long | bigint | no | Monotonic within a boot, starts at 0. |
| `observed_at` | TIMESTAMP | timestamptz | timestamp(6) with time zone | no | Robot clock. Used for partitioning and daily grains, never for ordering. |
| `robot_model` | STRING | string | varchar | no | From the RobotRegistered outbox event. |
| `firmware_version` | STRING | string | varchar | no | Firmware the event declares. |
| `battery_pct` | DOUBLE | double | double | no | Battery in percent [0, 100] after unit conversion. |
| `x_m` | DOUBLE | double | double | no | Position x in metres after unit conversion. |
| `y_m` | DOUBLE | double | double | no | Position y in metres after unit conversion. |
| `heading_rad` | DOUBLE | double | double | yes | Heading wrapped into [-pi, pi). NULL for writer schema revision 1 or a non-finite source value (see quality_flags). Frame and zero direction are unspecified by the contract (gap G5). |
| `motor_temp_c` | DOUBLE | double | double | yes | Motor temperature; NULL if absent or non-finite. |
| `lidar_ok` | BOOLEAN | boolean | boolean | yes | Lidar self-check; NULL if absent. |
| `source_battery_unit` | STRING | string | varchar | no | Firmware contract unit converted from. |
| `source_position_unit` | STRING | string | varchar | no | Firmware contract unit converted from. |
| `quality_flags` | ARRAY&lt;STRING&gt; | list&lt;string&gt; | array(varchar) | no | Field-level repairs and observations, sorted, e.g. HEADING_WRAPPED. |
| `schema_version` | INT | int | integer | no | Business contract major version (1). |
| `writer_schema_id` | BIGINT | long | bigint | no | Registry id of the writer schema. |
| `producer_id` | STRING | string | varchar | no | Producer identity (delivery metadata). |
| `produced_at` | TIMESTAMP | timestamptz | timestamp(6) with time zone | no | Producer clock at encoding (delivery metadata). |
| `correction_of` | STRING | string | varchar | yes | event_id this correction supersedes. |
| `superseded_by` | STRING | string | varchar | yes | Winning correction that replaced this event. |
| `is_current` | BOOLEAN | boolean | boolean | no | False when superseded_by is set. |
| `arrived_out_of_order` | BOOLEAN | boolean | boolean | no | An accepted event of the same robot with a greater (boot_number, sequence_number) arrived earlier. |
| `duplicate_deliveries` | INT | int | integer | no | Later identical copies of this event. |
| `source_topic` | STRING | string | varchar | no | Kafka topic name. |
| `kafka_topic_id` | STRING | string | varchar | no | Kafka topic id (incarnation). Changes when a topic is deleted and recreated. |
| `kafka_partition` | INT | int | integer | no | Kafka partition. |
| `kafka_offset` | BIGINT | long | bigint | no | Kafka offset within the partition. |
| `kafka_timestamp` | TIMESTAMP | timestamptz | timestamp(6) with time zone | yes | Kafka timestamp of the accepted copy. |
| `bronze_ingested_at` | TIMESTAMP | timestamptz | timestamp(6) with time zone | no | Bronze ingested_at of the accepted copy. |
| `silver_build_id` | STRING | string | varchar | no | Hash of (Bronze snapshot, reference data, transform version): equal ids mean identical inputs and therefore identical rows. |
| `transform_version` | STRING | string | varchar | no | Silver rule set version. |

## `silver.telemetry_record_outcomes`

Exactly one row per Bronze telemetry record: what Silver did with it and why. The quarantine is the REJECTED subset; the payload stays in Bronze (join on coordinates).

* Status: implemented (slice 1)
* Identity: `(kafka_topic_id, kafka_partition, kafka_offset)`
* Partitioning: `outcome, days(bronze_ingested_at)`
* Sort order: `kafka_partition, kafka_offset`

| Column | Spark | Iceberg | Trino | Null | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `source_topic` | STRING | string | varchar | no | Kafka topic name. |
| `kafka_topic_id` | STRING | string | varchar | no | Kafka topic id (incarnation). Changes when a topic is deleted and recreated. |
| `kafka_partition` | INT | int | integer | no | Kafka partition. |
| `kafka_offset` | BIGINT | long | bigint | no | Kafka offset within the partition. |
| `outcome` | STRING | string | varchar | no | ACCEPTED, DUPLICATE or REJECTED. |
| `reason_code` | STRING | string | varchar | yes | Set for REJECTED only. |
| `error_category` | STRING | string | varchar | yes | PERMANENT_DATA for REJECTED rows. |
| `retry_eligible` | BOOLEAN | boolean | boolean | no | Rejected only because reference data was missing; a rebuild after the reference data arrives can accept it. |
| `errors` | STRING | string | varchar | yes | JSON array of {code, field, message, ...} details. |
| `event_id` | STRING | string | varchar | yes | event_id if it could be read. |
| `robot_id` | STRING | string | varchar | yes | robot_id if it could be read. |
| `canonical_event_id` | STRING | string | varchar | yes | ACCEPTED: the event itself. DUPLICATE: the event_id whose first copy this repeats. |
| `superseded_by` | STRING | string | varchar | yes | Correction that superseded the event of this record. |
| `writer_schema_id` | BIGINT | long | bigint | yes | Schema id from the framing, if any. |
| `bronze_ingested_at` | TIMESTAMP | timestamptz | timestamp(6) with time zone | no | Bronze ingested_at. |
| `silver_build_id` | STRING | string | varchar | no | See silver.telemetry_events. |
| `transform_version` | STRING | string | varchar | no | Silver rule set version. |

## `gold.robot_daily_telemetry`

Fleet telemetry analytics: one row per robot and observed day, current events only.

* Status: specified, not implemented yet
* Identity: `(observed_date, robot_id)`
* Partitioning: `months(observed_date)`
* Sort order: none

| Column | Spark | Iceberg | Trino | Null | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `observed_date` | DATE | date | date | no | UTC date of observed_at. |
| `robot_id` | STRING | string | varchar | no | Robot. |
| `robot_model` | STRING | string | varchar | no | Robot model. |
| `events` | BIGINT | long | bigint | no | Current accepted events. |
| `boots` | BIGINT | long | bigint | no | Distinct boots with events that day. |
| `expected_events` | BIGINT | long | bigint | no | Sum over boots of (max - min sequence_number + 1) within the day. |
| `missing_sequences` | BIGINT | long | bigint | no | expected_events - events: lost, rejected or not yet arrived. |
| `out_of_order_events` | BIGINT | long | bigint | no | Events with arrived_out_of_order. |
| `duplicate_deliveries` | BIGINT | long | bigint | no | Sum of duplicate_deliveries. |
| `corrected_events` | BIGINT | long | bigint | no | Current events that are corrections. |
| `battery_pct_min` | DOUBLE | double | double | no | Minimum battery. |
| `battery_pct_avg` | DOUBLE | double | double | no | Mean battery over events. |
| `battery_pct_max` | DOUBLE | double | double | no | Maximum battery. |
| `distance_m` | DOUBLE | double | double | no | Sum of straight-line steps between consecutive sequence numbers of a boot; steps across a sequence gap are not counted. |
| `motor_temp_c_max` | DOUBLE | double | double | yes | Maximum motor temperature. |
| `lidar_fault_events` | BIGINT | long | bigint | no | Events with lidar_ok = false. |
| `first_observed_at` | TIMESTAMP | timestamptz | timestamp(6) with time zone | no | Earliest observed_at. |
| `last_observed_at` | TIMESTAMP | timestamptz | timestamp(6) with time zone | no | Latest observed_at. |
| `is_final` | BOOLEAN | boolean | boolean | no | Day older than the allowed lateness (7 days, Kafka retention): late arrivals can no longer change the row. |
| `silver_build_id` | STRING | string | varchar | no | Silver build the row was computed from. |

## `gold.robot_state_observations`

Training-candidate robot state observations with stable ids, provenance and a leakage-safe split. Not training-ready: see the readiness requirements in the spec.

* Status: specified, not implemented yet
* Identity: `(release_id, observation_id)`
* Partitioning: `release_id, split`
* Sort order: `robot_id, boot_number, sequence_number`

| Column | Spark | Iceberg | Trino | Null | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `release_id` | STRING | string | varchar | no | Dataset release (gold.training_dataset_releases). |
| `observation_id` | STRING | string | varchar | no | Silver event_id of the current version (the correction id when corrected). |
| `robot_id` | STRING | string | varchar | no | Robot. |
| `robot_model` | STRING | string | varchar | no | Robot model. |
| `firmware_version` | STRING | string | varchar | no | Firmware. |
| `episode_id` | STRING | string | varchar | no | boot_id until mission-aligned episodes are specified (gap G7). |
| `boot_number` | BIGINT | long | bigint | no | Boot ordinal. |
| `sequence_number` | BIGINT | long | bigint | no | Sequence within the boot. |
| `step_index` | BIGINT | long | bigint | no | sequence_number minus the first sequence_number of the episode in this release. |
| `observed_at` | TIMESTAMP | timestamptz | timestamp(6) with time zone | no | Robot clock. |
| `battery_pct` | DOUBLE | double | double | no | Canonical battery. |
| `x_m` | DOUBLE | double | double | no | Canonical x. |
| `y_m` | DOUBLE | double | double | no | Canonical y. |
| `heading_rad` | DOUBLE | double | double | yes | Canonical heading. |
| `motor_temp_c` | DOUBLE | double | double | yes | Motor temperature. |
| `lidar_ok` | BOOLEAN | boolean | boolean | yes | Lidar self-check. |
| `dt_prev_s` | DOUBLE | double | double | yes | Seconds since the previous sequence number of the same episode (observed_at); NULL at an episode start or after a sequence gap. |
| `vx_mps` | DOUBLE | double | double | yes | Finite-difference x velocity when dt_prev_s > 0. |
| `vy_mps` | DOUBLE | double | double | yes | Finite-difference y velocity when dt_prev_s > 0. |
| `split` | STRING | string | varchar | no | train, validation or test, by hash(episode_id, split_seed): no episode spans splits. |
| `quality_flags` | ARRAY&lt;STRING&gt; | list&lt;string&gt; | array(varchar) | no | Silver flags plus Gold flags. |
| `source_topic` | STRING | string | varchar | no | Kafka topic name. |
| `kafka_topic_id` | STRING | string | varchar | no | Kafka topic id (incarnation). Changes when a topic is deleted and recreated. |
| `kafka_partition` | INT | int | integer | no | Kafka partition. |
| `kafka_offset` | BIGINT | long | bigint | no | Kafka offset within the partition. |
| `silver_build_id` | STRING | string | varchar | no | Silver build. |
